loader_dependencies.frozen_v34_helper: Only module(), require_board(), source/weight/artifact constants, load_fast_config(), meta/plain/TorchDepthRNG are reused; its main() is not called.

loader_dependencies.explicit_approval: CLI --approved-stream-sha256 must equal fixed APPROVED_STREAM. It cannot approve arbitrary sources. Both baseline and candidate raw SHA plus exact two-line source transform are required before neural modules load.
loader_dependencies.upstream_guard: Candidate verify_sources() and its original six SOURCE_PINS are byte-identical; all original source manifest/94weight checks continue. No parent monkeypatch/import override.
loader_dependencies.runtime_policy: Entire StreamConfig equals SHA-cc6a original half (KF15 M16 L4R8O4); only hardcoded initial-motion rejection threshold is changed. Image/K/shared RNG/math/failure/ownership/close/EOF code is unchanged.
